Heard Mr. A. C. Sarmah, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Mr. B. Deuri, learned counsel for the petitioners.

Also heard Mr. N. Goswami, learned Government Advocate representing respondent Nos. 1, 2 and 3.
2.

The petitioners are aggrieved by the impugned order dated 14.05.2024 passed by the Additional Commissioner, (L.A.) Jorhat, District-Jorhat, whereby an order is made for paying compensation for the house standing on the land acquired covered by Dag No.749, P.P. No. 120 situated at Chungi Gaon under Titabor Mouza, Titabor Revenue Circle, in the District of Jorhat, Assam to the respondent No.4.
3.

In the said order, it is also recorded that there is a dispute among the pattadars with regard to the payment of compensation for the land measuring 15 Lechas covered by Dag No.749, P.P. No. 120 situated at Chungi Gaon under Titabor Mouza, Titabor Revenue Circle and the pattadars are not arrived at any compromise.

Learned Senior counsel for the petitioner referring to the Notification dated 27.05.2020 submits that the Department of Revenue and Disaster Management has issued the Notification notifying the Courts of the District and Sessions Judge of the Districts of Kamrup(M), Nagaon, Sonitpur, Jorhat and Cachar to continue to act as the Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority to exercise jurisdiction, powers and authority conferred under the Act.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned Senior counsel submits that in view of this Notification, the competent authority ought to have referred the matter for Page No.# 1/4 vs The State Of Assam And 3 Ors on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185127431/
2 adjudication before the Court instead of releasing the amount of compensation in favour of the private respondent No.4.
5.
Mr. N. Goswami, learned Government Advocate representing respondent Nos. 1, 2 and 3 prays for time to complete his instructions.
6. Accordingly, let Notice be issued returnable by 4 (four) weeks.
7. Since Mr. Goswami appears on behalf of the respondent Nos. 1, 2 and 3, Notices waived, however extra copies of the writ petition be furnished within a period of 1 (one) week from today.
8. Steps on respondent No.4 be taken by registered post with A/D as well as usual course.
9. Prayer for interim will be considered on the next returnable date.
10. Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner submits that this amount of compensation has not yet been disbursed till date to the respondent No.4.

If that be so, till the next returnable date, let the amount of compensation be not disbursed in terms of the order dated 30.12.2023 passed by Additional Commissioner, (L.A.) Jorhat, District-Jorhat read with the order dated 14.05.2024 passed by the said authority.
Page No.# 4/4 11. Matter be listed again on 29.07.2024.
